title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Three (3) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in geotechnical engineering basic projects regarding soil investigation and slope and street stabilization. b) Prepare reports and technical opinions about the basic projects of geotechnical engineering regarding soil investigation and slope, and street stabilization. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 - Auger and percussion drill – Area 1, 2 and 3 Description: A consortium will develop the projects, and the Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 45 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Geotechnical assessment – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop the projects, and the Geotechnical Engineer (Drill Specialist) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering, or related fields. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in Geotechnical Engineering roles is required.
• Training in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are desirable.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 (52% part-time) BRL: Total net amount) UNOPS Salary Scale The consultant will receive a total amount of BRL: 19.910, according to the following schedule:
• Payment 1 (56%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 1 (BRL
• Payment 2 (44%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 2 (BRL Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted into the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:

In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. title: Analista de Documentação
description:
DESCRIÇÃO
Nós acreditamos na capacidade de transformar a sociedade através da inovação e sustentabilidade. Por isso, nosso principal objetivo é contar com uma equipe motivada e inovadora, que atue em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor, visando sempre a excelência em nossas entregas. Se você tem desejo de transformar e acredita que pode agregar valor a desafios que envolvem responsabilidade social e ambiental, a Engemon é o lugar ideal

Ambiente De Trabalho
Irá trabalhar em nossa empresa de Engenharia.

Seus Desafios Serão
Gestão Documental de Engenharia

  • Emitir, registrar e controlar documentos técnicos (desenhos, memoriais, listas, procedimentos, relatórios, as built, etc.).
  • Garantir o correto preenchimento de carimbos, revisões, status e metadados.
  • Assegurar conformidade com padrões corporativos, normas técnicas e requisitos contratuais.

Controle de Qualidade Documental

  • Verificar formalmente e tecnicamente os documentos produzidos pelos projetistas antes da aprovação ou liberação.
  • Conferir clareza gráfica, legibilidade, numeração, referências cruzadas e aderência aos padrões.
  • Identificar não conformidades e devolver aos responsáveis com orientações claras.

Interface e Suporte Técnico

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre projetistas, coordenação e áreas usuárias.
  • Apoiar projetistas na aplicação correta dos padrões e fluxos documentais.

Gestão de Prazos e Fluxos

  • Monitorar prazos de entrega e apoiar o cumprimento do cronograma.
  • Liberar documentos já aprovados conforme matriz de responsabilidades, evitando retrabalho.
  • Controlar e registrar oficialmente a liberação para uso em obra, suprimentos e montagem.

Garantia de Versões Válidas

  • Assegurar que apenas versões aprovadas estejam disponíveis para execução.
  • Disponibilizar documentos atualizados e rastreáveis para a equipe de campo.
  • Controlar distribuição, recolhimento e substituição de documentos obsoletos.

Melhoria Contínua e Sistema ACC

  • Propor melhorias nos processos de emissão, verificação, aprovação e liberação.
  • Apoiar a implementação e uso do sistema de gestão documental ACC.
  • Atuar preventivamente para evitar gargalos e retrabalho.

Autoridade e Autonomia

  • Autoridade para bloquear documentos com não conformidades.
  • Autonomia para liberar documentos já aprovados conforme procedimentos vigentes.

Valorizado

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Engenharia, Arquitetura, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em documentação técnica de engenharia e/ou projetos multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento sólido em normas técnicas, processos de revisão e controle de versões.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão documental e plataformas colaborativas.
  • Domínio na leitura e interpretação de projetos técnicos.

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Comunicação eficaz para estabelecer um relacionamento sólido com o cliente;
  • Trabalho em equipe para fomentar um ambiente amigável;
  • Organização para gerenciar as demandas cotidianas;
  • Dinamismo para enfrentar uma variedade de atividades e desafios.

Porque Trabalhar Na Engemon
Trabalhar na Engemon significa integrar uma empresa com uma história rica, enfrentar uma diversidade de projetos estimulantes, ter oportunidades para o desenvolvimento pessoal, fazer parte de uma cultura organizacional que preza pela colaboração, saúde e bem-estar, e contribuir para projetos que geram impactos positivos. Além disso, você estará em um ambiente que valoriza e incentiva a tecnologia e a inovação contínua.

O Que Oferecemos Para Você

  • Saúde e bem- estar, pois oferecemos assistência médica, odontológica, seguro de vida e TotalPass porque você é nosso maior compromisso.
  • Reconhecimento porque queremos seu protagonismo e oferecemos um plano de carreira competitivo.
  • Deslocamento temos o VT para auxiliar no transporte do dia a dia.
  • Autonomia com o vale refeição em um cartão que tem flexibilidade para uso em diversos estabelecimentos.

title: Técnico(a) Manutenção Mecânica Júnior
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.
Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.
Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).
Local de atuação: Santa Cruz, RJ
Responsabilidades:
Executar e acompanhar manutenções em equipamentos da laminação (cilindros, rolamentos, bombas, redutores, mesas transportadoras, sistemas hidráulicos e pneumáticos);

Conduzir inspeções mecânicas, identificar falhas;

Realizar desmontagem, substituição e montagem de componentes mecânicos de grande porte suportando técnicos mecânicos plenos;

Participar do planejamento e execução de paradas programadas;

Apoiar no diagnóstico de falhas e melhorias de confiabilidade;

Garantir a correta utilização de ferramentas e instrumentos de medição;

Cumprir e zelar pelas normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.

Requisitos:
Formação técnica em Mecânica, Manutenção Industrial ou Eletromecânica.

Sólida experiência em manutenção mecânica industrial, preferencialmente em siderurgia ou áreas de laminação;

Conhecimentos em desenho técnico mecânico, metrologia, hidráulica, pneumática e lubrificação;

Desejável experiência em análise de falhas e manutenção de equipamentos industriais;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em regime de turno e horário sazonal (14:25 às 23:50) de segunda a sexta feira.

O que buscamos?
Capacidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas;

Proatividade e iniciativa para propor melhorias;

Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinares, possuir boa comunicação com os colaboradores.

Comprometimento com segurança e qualidade das entregas.

Principais atividades:

  • Realizar check-list dos equipamentos a serem utilizados, preenchendo o formulário de pré-uso, garantindo o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos e minimizando os riscos de acidentes com os colaboradores;
  • Efetuar a manutenção corretiva em máquinas e equipamentos industriais, de acordo com a matriz de capacitação, realizando inspeções periódicas, identificando e/ou diagnosticando anomalias, falhas e defeitos através da avaliação técnica, providenciar os devidos reparos, em conformidade com os procedimentos preestabelecidos para a execução dos serviços;
  • Efetuar e monitorar manutenções preventivas, realizando diagnósticos com instrumentos específicos, analisando as diversas variáveis, bem como interpretando e emitindo os resultados / laudos obtidos com as medições, de forma a subsidiar as tomadas de decisões acerca das ações preventivas;
  • Elaborar escopos de serviços e especificações técnicas para realização das manutenções, serviços de recuperação e aquisições de máquinas e componentes, utilizando manuais e desenhos técnicos, bem como encaminhando a demanda para programação;

Executar serviços de reparo e manutenção preventiva e corretiva de menor complexidade nos equipamentos e instalações inerentes a área de atuação Laminador fio máquina e barras, utilizando ferramentas diversas, visando o cumprimento do plano de manutenção e emergências.

Cumprir as orientações de normas e procedimentos de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente, de acordo com as políticas da Empresa.

Cuidar da conservação de ferramentas, instrumentos, bem como da limpeza do seu local de trabalho.

Receber e preparar ferramentas, equipamentos e materiais necessários para execução dos serviços de manutenção mecânica.

Movimentar carga em geral dentro das áreas da Empresa, operando talha e ponte rolante, empilhadeira visando atender as necessidades de serviço.

Auxiliar na montagem, desmontagem e correção de conjuntos mecânicos e equipamentos, utilizando ferramentas básicas de trabalho, com objetivo de atender as necessidades de serviço.

Utilizar ferramentas rotativas, para fabricações de caldeiraria e atividades diárias.

Executar a lubrificação de equipamentos e componente, verificar nível de óleo e efetuar coleta para amostragem de óleo.

Executar o plano de lubrificação, imprimindo ordens, dando retorno e encerrando as mesmas, para gerar notas de avarias, quando necessário.

Realizar a manutenção e limpeza de sistemas hidráulicos, pneumáticos e equipamentos, utilizando ferramentas básicas de serviço, visando mantê-los disponíveis.

Realizar a montagem, desmontagem e correção de defeito em tubulações, utilizando ferramentas básicas de serviço, visando atender as necessidades do processo.

Executar serviços de reparo e fabricação de menor complexidade, utilizando máquina de solda de eletrodo revestido e oxicorte.

Executar, sob orientação, a troca ou reparo de engrenagens, acoplamentos, roletes, mancais, rolamentos e demais componentes mecânicos de máquinas e equipamentos visando manter o funcionamento dos mesmos.

Realizar inspeção de ronda e registrar anomalias em softwares específicos, para tomada de medidas cabíveis.

Executar outras atividades correlatas à área de atuação, a critério do líder responsável.

Manter-se atualizado quanto às questões legais e pertinentes ao cargo.

Atender às manutenções corretivas não planejadas. Registrar no SAP/PM com boa qualidade todas as ordens de manutenção executadas em seu turno conforme o procedimento Gerdau do MAP e conforme lista de tarefas. Cumprir a programação vinda do PCM. Participar de tratamento de falhas quando solicitado. Interagir com a operação nos DSD's e G24 horas e durante turno. Realizar rondas nos equipamentos conforme programação do PCM. Manter os locais de trabalho e frente de serviço limpos e organizados, fazendo o descarte correto dos resíduos gerados durante as atividades de manutenção.

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

title: FARM GLOBAL
description:
A nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

Em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

Hoje temos no nosso ecossistema as marcas FARM RIO BR, FARM RIO GLOBAL, FARM Etc, FARM LATAM e FABULA , com mais de 120 lojas e 2000 mil colaboradores temos a missão de fazer o outro mais feliz que entrou.

Somos GENTE Boa, bom de GENTE, e bom de JOGO e acreditamos que a gentileza, o encantamento, a paixão, a inclusão e eficiência são a chave de tudo que fazemos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Responsável por executar e operacionalizar todas as iniciativas de Treinamento e Cultura, garantindo organização, logística, qualidade e padronização dos processos, desde a preparação de conteúdos até o acompanhamento de treinamentos e eventos.

  • Apoiar a execução de todas as frentes de treinamento, ajudando na organização de conteúdos, agendas e materiais.
  • Realizar a logística e operacionalização dos ambientes de desenvolvimento: gravações, transmissões no TEAMS, eventos presenciais, gestão de conteúdos na plataforma de treinamento e desenvolvimento, e nos canais de comunicação interna.
  • Auxiliar na roteirização, produção executiva, gravação, edição e organização de materiais complementares.
  • Acompanhar e dar suporte na realização de movimentos de desenvolvimento (Onboarding, programas de liderança, formações, workshops e eventos anuais).
  • Garantir controle de prazos, checklist de produção e padronização das entregas.
  • Coletar feedbacks e apoiar na avaliação da eficácia dos treinamentos.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a liderança para viabilizar as ações da área, assegurando que as etapas operacionais estejam concluídas dentro do prazo e padrão esperado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior/técnico (completo).
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório), contato direto com o time comercial das lojas fora Brasil.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita (Inglês e Português).
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Experiência em apoio a projetos de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento ou áreas afins.

percepção para realizar uma limpeza minuciosa, garantindo que áreas críticas estejam sempre bem cuidadas.

iniciativa para identificar necessidades de manutenção e limpeza, agindo antes de ser solicitado.

capacidade de colaborar com colegas, auxiliando em tarefas coletivas e mantendo um bom relacionamento interpessoal.

habilidade para lidar com tarefas que exigem esforço físico, como movimentação de materiais, limpeza de áreas amplas ou repetição de atividades ao longo do dia.

  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).
Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

description:
No Grupo GSS, nos orgulhamos de ser uma empresa moderna e dinâmica, com valores sólidos que orientam todas as nossas ações. Nossos pilares de Idoneidade, Ética, Inovação, Qualidade, Confiabilidade, Inteligência e Respeito refletem nosso compromisso em entregar o melhor serviço, sempre com responsabilidade e excelência. Estamos à procura de profissionais que compartilhem de nossos valores e que desejem fazer parte de um time dedicado e engajado em superar expectativas. Valorizamos colaboradores com iniciativa, proatividade e desejo de entregar o melhor em suas funções. Se você é comprometido, atento aos detalhes e deseja contribuir para o sucesso de uma empresa que preza pela integridade e inovação, a GSS é o lugar certo para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
A pessoa auxiliar de serviços gerais deverá atuar entre outras atividades em:

Limpeza e conservação: realizar a limpeza de áreas comuns, escritórios, banheiros, refeitórios e outros locais designados, utilizando produtos e equipamentos adequados, para manter o ambiente higienizado e organizado.

Coleta de lixo: recolher, separar e destinar corretamente os resíduos, zelando pela manutenção da limpeza e higiene nos espaços de trabalho.

Conservação de equipamentos: garantir o bom uso e a conservação dos equipamentos de limpeza, armazenando-os corretamente após o uso e solicitando manutenção ou substituição quando necessário.

Cumprimento de normas de segurança: Seguir as diretrizes de segurança no trabalho, utilizando corretamente os EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e zelando pela prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações
Para esta vaga a pessoa candidata deve possuir as habilidades:

Organização:
capacidade de manter ambientes limpos e organizados, além de gerenciar tarefas eficientemente.

Atenção aos detalhes:
percepção para realizar uma limpeza minuciosa, garantindo que áreas críticas estejam sempre bem cuidadas.

Proatividade:
iniciativa para identificar necessidades de manutenção e limpeza, agindo antes de ser solicitado.

Trabalho em equipe:
capacidade de colaborar com colegas, auxiliando em tarefas coletivas e mantendo um bom relacionamento interpessoal.

Resistência física:
habilidade para lidar com tarefas que exigem esforço físico, como movimentação de materiais, limpeza de áreas amplas ou repetição de atividades ao longo do dia.

Pontualidade e responsabilidade:
comprometimento com horários e qualidade na execução das tarefas diárias.

Capacidade de seguir normas e instruções:
atenção ao cumprimento de regras, incluindo normas de segurança, uso correto de EPIs e procedimentos operacionais.

Flexibilidade:
adaptabilidade para lidar com diferentes demandas, como pequenas manutenções ou apoio a outras áreas da empresa.

Deve possuir experiência prévia como copeira.

title: Analista de Planejamento Tributário Sênior
description:
A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Tributário Sênior e a missão dessa posição é ser responsável pela identificação de oportunidades de créditos tributários e no suporte à elaboração de estratégias de planejamento tributário, garantindo conformidade fiscal, redução de riscos e otimização da carga tributária, com foco em resultados financeiros, além de apoio às estratégias corporativas da organização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Identificar, analisar e apurar oportunidades de créditos tributários nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, garantindo aderência à legislação vigente;
  • Conduzir estudos e análises para recuperação de créditos tributários, incluindo elaboração de memórias de cálculo, relatórios técnicos e suporte à escrituração;
  • Desenvolver e apoiar a implementação de estratégias de planejamento tributário, visando a otimização da carga tributária e a mitigação de riscos fiscais;
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária, incluindo a Reforma, avaliando impactos e propondo adequações nos processos e estratégias fiscais da companhia;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas internas (contábil, fiscal, jurídico e negócios), orientando quanto aos impactos tributários das operações;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos tributários, identificando oportunidades de eficiência e automação.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou area correlacionadas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Planejamento Tributário e/ou Reforma Tributária;
  • Conhecimento sólido na área tributária, com atuação em planejamento tributário e levantamento/recuperação de créditos tributários;

  • Vivência em análise da legislação tributária e aplicação prática em operações do ramo de varejo;

  • Ter atuado em planejamento tributário e levantamento/recuperação de créditos tributários;

  • Conhecimento específico em planejamento tributário e apuração de créditos tributários.

SoftSkill:
- Perfil analítico e pensamento estratégico;
- Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva com diferentes áreas;
- Organização, atenção a detalhes e gestão de prazos;
- Proatividade, autonomia e senso crítico;
- Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas demandas;

  • Experiência na elaboração de estudos técnicos, pareceres e memórias de cálculo.

title: Drilling Engineer
description:
The Drilling Engineer will support BWE Brazil's Drilling & Completion (D&C) team on Brazilian assets, focusing on the Maromba Phase I development drilling campaign. This role ensures compliance with company policies and standards, manages directional planning databases, and coordinates interfaces between engineering, operations, logistics, and subsurface teams.

Responsabilities:

  • Specifically work with the D&C Well Delivery Team on the Maromba development phase I drilling campaign.
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Manage Maromba wells directional planning database plus survey database.
  • Drafting and owning project Directional Surveying Policy.
  • Manage the interfaces between engineering, operations, logistics and subsurface during all phases of the well/project.
  • Liaison and management of daily interface between D&C and all stakeholders.
  • Support drilling engineering projects for Brazilian assets.
  • Work with the Well Delivery Team on Maromba Phase I drilling campaign.
  • Manage directional planning and survey databases (Compass).
  • Draft and maintain the project's Directional Surveying Policy.
  • Perform torque, drag, and hydraulics analysis using industry software for program optimization.
  • Assist in well planning, design, engineering, costing, and operational execution.
  • Prepare scopes of work for tenders, evaluate vendors, and draft award recommendations.
  • Ensure Well Barrier Schematics are current and valid.
  • Maintain campaign performance database (TvD curves, NPT records, KPIs).
  • Coordinate After Action Reviews (AAR) and Lessons Learned database.
  • Engage and manage service companies to ensure safe and efficient delivery.
  • Participate in risk assessments, DWOP/CWOP, and pre-job planning meetings.

Requirements


Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

Experience:

  • 6–8 years in drilling engineering with operators or service companies in Brazil.
  • Experience in multi-well development projects with directional/horizontal wells.
  • Proficiency in Landmark tools (Wellplan, StressCheck, Compass) or equivalents.

title: Budgetist (Engineer)
description:
Result of Service

The Budgetist (Engineer) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Budgetist (Engineer) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Budgetist (Engineer) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Budgetist (Engineer) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Set parameters, standards, and requirements for budget engineering. b) Set guidelines for planning and development of architecture and urban infrastructure basic projects. c) Prepare technical guidelines, budget spreadsheets with costs and quantities, and detailed data survey needs for bidding civil construction works. d) Analyze and review materials quantities spreadsheet regarding architecture and engineering basic projects for residential buildings and urban infrastructures. e) Analyze and review budget spreadsheet and Its unity cost composition, calculate indirect benefits and expenses (BDI), elaborate "ABC" and "S" curves, elaborate civil construction work program and control, elaborate physical-financial graphics and progress. f) Prepare reports and technical analysis on residential building and urban infrastructure budgets. g) Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to budget engineering. h) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects. i) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. j) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. k) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Budgetist (Engineer) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Budget – Social Housing Description: A consortium will design the budget, and the Budgetist (Engineer) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 80 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Budget – Area 1 Description: A consortium will design the budget, and the Budgetist (Engineer) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 160 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Budget – Area 2 Description: A consortium will design the budget, and the Budgetist (Engineer) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 240 days after signing the contract. Product 4 – Technical Review Description: The Budgetist (Engineer) will verify the overall deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Budget, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Civil Engineering, or related fields. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in budget engineering is required.
• Experience in the context of urbanization of informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, and Microsoft Team are required.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable.
• Experience and skills in using BIM are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 (12% part-time) BRL: Total net amount) UNOPS Salary Scale The consultant will receive a total amount of BRL: 16.847, according to the following schedule:

ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Architect
description:
Result of Service

The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Architect is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Architect will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
• Review of Program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural design.

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Sanitation Engineer (Drainage Project) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 65 days after signing the contract. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 130 days after signing the contract. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 195 days after signing the contract. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

title: Sanitation Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte". UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora", which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, a Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze, review, and, when necessary, suggest adjustments in drainage basic projects and ensure compatibility with sewage and water network projects designed by the local concessionaires. b) Prepare reports and technical assessments on drainage projects. c) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. d) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, and engineers. e) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. f) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. g) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 - Hydrological studies – Area 1 Description: A consortium will develop hydrological studies, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 65 days after signing the contract. Product 2 - Hydrological studies – Area 2 Description: A consortium will develop hydrological studies, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 130 days after signing the contract. Product 3 - Hydrological studies – Area 3 Description: A consortium will develop hydrological studies, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 195 days after signing the contract. Product 4 – Drainage analysis for box culvert project Description: A consortium will design four (4) box culvert projects, and the Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 260 days after signing the contract. Product 5 – Technical report review – Area 1, 2, and 3 Description: The Sanitation Engineer (Hydrological Studies) will review technical reports on drainage projects for three (3) areas. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Civil Engineering or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related fields. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of professional experience in sanitation engineering roles is required, especially related to drainage and sustainable urban drainage design.
• Experience in the use of nature-based solutions is desirable.
• Experience in design and/or work in informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

O Colégio Anglo-Americano, instituição de ensino de natureza privada, foi fundado em 1919, como British American School, pela educadora Maguerth Coney, com a finalidade principal de atender a filhos de diplomatas radicados na então capital federal.

Na década de 70, já sob a direção do Prof. Ney Suassuna, o Colégio passou por significativas transformações em sua orientação pedagógica e grande expansão no plano nacional e internacional.

Coerentes com a busca na construção do aprender a aprender, com responsabilidade e comprometimento pelo próprio aprendizado, consolidou sua marca nesses 104 anos de existência, uma imagem que integra tradição e modernidade, estando sempre na vanguarda da Educação formando empreendedores bilíngues.

O Anglo-Americano recebe alunos da Educação Infantil ao Ensino Médio e tem seu Projeto Pedagógico definido como cognitivista, com ênfase no sócio interacionismo. O Anglo informa, forma e transforma seus alunos, em processo constante de ação e reflexão, compromissado em prepará-los para as etapas seguintes do aprendizado e para atuação criativa e empreendedora na vida.

title: tecnico seguranca do trabalho
description:
TECNICO SEGURANCA DO TRABALHO

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

The domain of safety is managed and developed on the site:

  • The external and internal requirements of the domain are identified (regulatory watch and prescriptions). Based on gap analyses, action plans are proposed. The guarantee of the site's compliance with internal regulations and requirements is controlled.
  • The site has relevant and exhaustive risk analyses and action plans are defined.
  • In the context of design projects, the purchase of new machines, technical transformations of equipment or organizational changes in jobs, the position of the site safety specialist is defined and transmitted to the project team in the form of an "Avis EP".
  • The current operating anomalies in the domain are analysed and taken into account. The necessary alerts are transmitted.
  • Good practices are shared within the site and across the country. The site safety specialist participates in or leads the business meetings of his network.
  • The annual review of the domain is presented by the site safety specialist during the EP Management Sytem Review of the site.
  • The safety specialist is the leader in his domain in terms of team support, management system and site events: steering committees, bib events, training.
  • External and internal partners are identified, and the safety specialist is the site's referent in these networks.
  • Technical support in the domain will be provided in the event of an audit (EP Management system or other audit/inspection) and in the event of a crisis impacting the area.
  • If necessary, specific projects in the field will be conducted in the form of transversal management (T-shape for example).
  • Where possible, participation in audits of other sites or even the conduct of audits will be entrusted to the site's safety specialist.
  • Where possible, the coordination of the domain at the country level will be carried out by the site safety specialist, under the guidance of the time zone.

  • Assistência Médica e Hospitalar, Odontológica: Cuidados de saúde completos para empregados e seus dependentes, prezando por aquilo que é prioritário em garantir: Saúde e qualidade de vida; 
  • Reembolso Creche ou Auxílio Babá: apoio para conciliar o retorno ao trabalho com a chegada de um filho - até os 6 anos dos dependentes;
  • PASA - Planos de saúde para familiares ou para o próprio empregado, em caso de aposentadoria ou desligamento;
  • Vale alimentação: suporte financeiro para compras de itens de mercado;
  • Vale refeição ou Refeições no trabalho: benefício para facilitar a rotina e promover hábitos saudáveis na alimentação diária;
  • Apoiar - Programa de Assistência ao Empregado e Dependentes: suporte emocional e social especializados para empregados e suas famílias;
  • Cartão Presente de Natal para Dependentes: um gesto de carinho no final do ano - para dependentes até 10 anos;
  • Transporte fretado ou Vale transporte: garantia de deslocamento diário de nossos empregados para o ambiente de trabalho;
  • Incentivo à atividade física - Wellhub: promoção de saúde física e bem-estar com programas de atividade física;
  • Programa Bem-Estar: cuidados integrais para melhorar a qualidade de vida dos empregados;
  • Clube de Vantagens: Descontos e benefícios exclusivos para compras em estabelecimentos parceiros.

Como é trabalhar na Vale Metais Básicos? Na Vale Metais Básicos, contribuímos para a formação de futuros. Da mineração, do planeta e o seu. Oferecemos oportunidades para diversas áreas e objetivos profissionais. Aqui, nossos talentos constroem juntos um ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo que valoriza a pessoa como ela é: sua individualidade, seu protagonismo e comprometimento. Na Vale Metais Básicos, aprendemos juntos. Acreditamos na riqueza das experiências do dia a dia e na troca de conhecimento entre os talentos. Aqui, todo momento pode e deve ser um aprendizado. Na Vale Metais Básicos, também crescemos juntos. Estabelecemos relações sólidas e de valor compartilhado com os nossos empregados e a sociedade. Assim, demonstramos nosso comprometimento com um legado positivo, resultados consistentes e com a construção de uma mineração com processos mais inovadores e sustentáveis: a mineração do futuro.   Onde tem futuro, o Grupo Vale está.  Ficou curioso para conhecer um pouco mais do Grupo Vale? Acesse  e Conheça também nossa Política de diversidade   A Vale e a Vale Metais Básicos não realizam nenhum tipo de cobrança para participação em nenhuma etapa dos seus processos seletivos.  Todas as candidaturas devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso site  ou por meio de vagas postadas no  perfil da Vale no LinkedIn .   Obs: Se você já se candidatou a esta vaga anteriormente, o botão para o envio de candidatura não estará disponível. Caso seja selecionado no processo seletivo, entraremos em contato para informar sobre o resultado da seleção.

title: Vigilante - RJ
description:

Nosso papel é autenticar, autorizar e garantir a segurança de todos os envolvidos. Isso é o que fazemos para cada um dos nossos mais de 1.200 clientes no Brasil e no mundo.

Nosso jeito Valid
Na Valid, acreditamos que cada pessoa é única e nosso propósito é empoderar o que há de mais genuíno em cada uma, criando um ambiente onde todos possam evoluir e deixar suas marcas.

Valorizamos profissionais que construam relações de confiança com clientes externos, parceiros e outras áreas da empresa, que foquem em melhorar o que já existe ou criar coisas novas, que busquem a excelência nas entregas e pratiquem a colaboração em equipe.

Tudo isso faz parte da nossa Cultura, do nosso jeito Valid, que se traduz nos nossos quatro valores:

  • Somos movidos pelo cliente
  • Nunca paramos de evoluir e aprender
  • Fazemos acontecer e fazemos bem-feito
  • Jogamos juntos e jogamos limpo.

É isso que nos permite continuar construindo uma história de sucesso e crescimento e que dá vida ao nosso propósito todos os dias.

Aqui, nós valorizamos oportunidades igualitárias e estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente seguro, respeitoso e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência ou qualquer outra base.

  • Controlar entradas e saídas de materiais, funcionários e visitantes nas dependências da empresa, bem como orientar sobre as instruções de segurança;
  • Realizar rondas na empresa;
  • São responsáveis pela segurança em sua área de atuação, devendo zelar diretamente pelo produto acabado, maquinários, matéria prima, resíduos, etc., exercendo constante fiscalização;
  • Realizar monitoramento sistema de CFTV e testes do sistema de alarme;
  • Ser responsável pela segurança em sua área de atuação, devendo zelar diretamente pelo produto acabado, maquinários, matéria prima, resíduos, etc., exercendo constante fiscalização;

description:

Fundada em 2012, nossa jornada é marcada por uma paixão inabalável por inovar e entregar valor, combinando Venda Consultiva, um forte Canal Digital e Eficiência Operacional em cada passo que damos.

Somos uma empresa com uma visão ousada.
